M4_5_EXACT_TITLE: Portable Plan Mutation Port + Multi-Domain Precondition Model + Mutation Journal Contract
M4_5_PRIMARY_OBJECTIVE: Define and freeze the executor-neutral Portable Plan Mutation Port, multi-domain precondition model (Subject CAS vs external authority CAS vs semantic normalized digest), and durable mutation journal contract that together establish the mechanical external mutation and recovery boundary without implementing the GitHub-specific adapter or durable recovery execution.
M4_5_PREREQUISITES: M4-1 Mutation Intent / Operation Descriptor / Canonical Mutation Result Contract completed (d74953be)
M4-2 Trusted Mutation Authorization + Capability Lease Issuance Protocol completed (16826b55)
M4-4 PLAN_INIT / Retirement Mechanical Lifecycle + Project Steward Mechanical Invocation Boundary completed (16826b55)
M4-3 Write-Capable Unified Ingress completed (26e61687) with received-lease-only, closed plan_init/plan_retirement, authorization-bound idempotency

M4-0 D1-D12 architecture decisions frozen, in particular D2 no cross-authority atomic transaction, D3 external mutation journal protocol, D4 pre-write bindings, D5 trusted auth/lease separation, D6 revision/digest domains

M4_DAG.verified_against: architecture freeze D1-D12 and Issue #9 M4 section

M4_5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: Portable Plan Mutation Port contract frozen (executor-neutral, typed operation/target/correlation/contract/idempotency/intent, bounded authorization + lease reference, Subject and raw authority preconditions, candidate/normalized digests)

Multi-domain revision/digest model frozen: subject_expected_revision for Subject CAS, raw_source_revision + observed_raw_digest for external CAS, normalized_plan_digest as semantic evidence only; candidate_raw_digest binds exact intent; SUBJECT_REVISION != AUTHORITY_SOURCE_REVISION != NORMALIZED_PLAN_DIGEST

Mutation journal contract frozen with states PREPARED, APPLYING, OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, RECONCILING, VERIFIED, VERIFIED_RECOVERED, FAILED_NO_EFFECT, RETRYABLE_NO_EFFECT, CONFLICT and required write order (authorization→Subject precondition→external read→raw precondition→candidate→PREPARED durable→APPLYING durable→at most one external attempt→readback→classify→terminal/reconciliation persist)

Pre-write authority snapshot contract frozen (operation, principal, typed target, correlation, contract/idempotency/intent fingerprints, Subject and raw authority preconditions, normalized/candidate digests, authorization/lease reference, journal state; secrets and raw GitHub IDs excluded)
Read-before-write required, verify-after-write required; unknown outcome requires deterministic reconciliation; no semantic rollback; no heuristic reconciliation
Three-way reconciliation rule frozen (ORIGINAL vs CANDIDATE vs OBSERVED raw identity with precedence candidate > original > third-state=CONFLICT); normalized equality is supporting evidence only

Retry authorization rule frozen: UNKNOWN_OUTCOME_BLIND_LEASE_REUSE=no; stranded APPLYING reconciles before retry; RETRYABLE_NO_EFFECT requires fresh authorization + Subject + raw preconditions + bounded lease/attempt
Cross-authority atomic transaction explicitly denied; journal is not semantic decision maker; platform neutrality preserved (Core != GitHub transport)
Operation contract reuse: plan_init and plan_retirement remain the only external mutation operations; no generic mutation API

Canonical result reuse without adapter-specific semantics; materialized operations surface VERIFIED/VERIFIED_RECOVERED/FAILED_NO_EFFECT/RETRYABLE_NO_EFFECT/CONFLICT/OUTCOME_UNKNOWN via existing MutationEffect
Downstream M4-6 (GitHub Issue/Control-Comment Authority Adapter) and M4-7 (Durable Journal + Reconciliation execution) contracts defined and left unimplemented
Source ownership, gap map, implementation DAG, acceptance matrix, failure injection plan, and downstream handoff produced; construction-time semantic decision count = 0
